full_text: Intro Game-Changing Encompass Plugins That Will Transform Your Workflow in 2026 Home » Game-Changing Encompass Plugins That Will Transform Your Workflow in 2026 The mortgage industry has many hurdles to overcome to speed up the mortgage process and the long intervals of time to accomplish each of these steps, repetitive data entry, and manual verification processes. Today’s borrowers are expecting lenders to be quick. So, lenders require service solutions to match the rising demand from customers. It is a fact that lenders are under enormous pressure from their customers to deliver loans faster. On average lenders, using their platforms reduce their entire loan closing time by an average of 23.5 hours. This increased efficiency will enable lenders to be more productive and decrease their costs. Many inefficient processes involved with data entry, document retrieval processes, and switching from one software application to another will cause the lender to experience a delay in closing a loan, frustrate their customers and employees. With increasing consumer demand for faster loan approvals and improved service quality, technology has the potential to help meet these customer demands. The use of Encompass plugins will enable lenders to take advantage of technology’s potential for improved service delivery for their customers. The function of a Plugin is automating repetitive processes, integrating with various systems and reducing the total amount of manual work needed to close a loan. As such, lenders can close a loan faster, with increased accuracy and spend more time on things that are most important to them. Understanding Encompass Plugins Encompass LOS plugins are merely software additions to the LOS, which adds functionality that isn’t available in the core product. These plugins are designed to provide complementary features by allowing multiple applications to work together, by completing common actions and by facilitating the sharing of information between applications. A number of plugins within Encompass utilize APIs or middleware to provide real-time or scheduled (batch) data feeds to/from other applications. Thinking about how Encompass plugins increase productivity? Encompass LOS plugins allow users to eliminate the need to manually import or export data. It determines whether to utilize real-time or batch synchronization. Current Challenges in Traditional Mortgage Workflows Many mortgage companies continue to utilize time-consuming manual procedures despite the many available digital tools that increase productivity. Using duplication makes it more likely that human error will occur due to typos, field misalignment, and the omission of requirements, which forces a redo of work. Bottlenecks are frequent as a result of prolonged document turnaround time, inconsistent data across various systems and being delayed making an approval. The added delays to the process not only extend the overall time it takes to process a loan, but negatively impact the profitability of all facets of residential mortgage lending Delays caused by these problems will not only slow down the processing of loans, but also affect the lender’s bottom line. By delaying the bank’s response time to borrowers and not being transparent with updates, the lender can face penalties based on each day of delay. Slow response times; unclear updates; and lengthy time frames for loan closing can significantly reduce borrower satisfaction; and increase fallout rates. The Power of Automation with Plugins Loan processors & loan officers will have more time available to do more meaningful work by automating tasks rather than manually performing them. On average, by utilizing the best Encompass plugins for mortgage lending, lenders will typically receive approximately 20% to 30% less processing time; plus, they reduce errors significantly. As a result of these positive outcomes, lenders are able to provide a higher level of service to their customers and are able to process loans much faster. One team, by using electronic methods for performing tasks instead of traditional paper methods, saved themselves hours of time for each loan processed. By creating a more efficient process and increasing accuracy and speed, this team was able to serve their customers much better and provide a more positive customer experience. Categories of Encompass LOS Plugins Plugin Category Example Benefit Automation & Workflow Loan automation plugin Time savings on repetitive tasks, quicker, easier approval process, save hours per day Compliance & Risk Management Regulatory alert plugin Compliance with current laws; reduced penalties due to compliance CRM & Communication Borrower communication plugin Automation of emails/texts/reminders for improved client engagement Document Management eFolder integration Centralized documents, automated indexing and retrieval Reporting & Analytics Dashboard plugin Real-time tracking of KPIs, loan pipelines, and team performance AI & Predictive Credit risk predictor Identification of early potential risks to help make underwriting decisions Post-closing & Pipeline Customization Post-close quality check plugin Helps ensure completed loans aligned with required standards Deep Dive: Automation Plugins That Save Hours Daily Using trigger-based notifications keeps all members on the team informed and provides a standardised process for tracking actions and deadlines. By utilizing automated notifications and response times, lenders improve and team members work together more efficiently. Compliance & Risk Management Plugins Compliance plugins assist lenders in managing their regulations continuously changing such as: CFPB-Rules, TRID, HMDA Reporting. Automation of regulatory checks, maintaining audit-ready documentation, real-time dashboards for tracking of exceptions, deadlines & risk factors are also part of the compliance and security plugin(s) functionalities. The compliance plugin(s) enabled one mid-size mortgage company to reduce manual compliance review by 60%. They assist in reducing the chances of costly errors. So, there are lesser fines, streamlined internal audit processes, and less complexity of regulatory compliance. CRM & Client Communication Integration Plugins The CRM plugin will centralize borrower data, collecting information on every interaction with the borrower from the first time they inquire about a loan to the point when the loan is closed. It includes automatic follow-up and reminder and alert features which enable borrowers to receive all essential communication. The report from 2026 shows that lenders who use integrated CRMs have achieved 18% better customer retention because their communication with borrowers has become more timely and consistent. The lender who uses CRMs has automated their loan status updates and appointment reminders through their implementation of the system. Document Management Plugins The document management plugins handle the complete process of borrower file intake and validation and file storage. They automatically capture files because it eliminates the need for users to perform manual document scanning, document labeling and document uploading tasks. The process checks document completeness while it determines whether any data elements are missing or incomplete. The secured storage of documents enables organizations to retrieve documents whenever they need them for audit purposes or compliance checks or secondary market delivery. The plugins prevent document loss and stop typographical errors from happening. Ultimately, this prevents data mismatches from occurring because they remove the need for manual document processing. Example: The mid-sized lender achieved a 45% reduction in document errors and they decreased their manual document intake process by 50% after they implemented document automation plugins. Reporting & Analytics Plugins The reporting and analytics plugins create dashboards which track loan pipelines and KPIs and team performance in real time. The advanced analytics system provides users with tools to analyze current trends and predict future workload and discover processing delays before they start to impact operations. The lender used analytics to identify potential sources of delay which allowed them to implement business changes that reduced workflow bottlenecks by more than 30%. AI-Powered & Predictive Plugins Is this question ‘’how to improve Encompass workflow efficiency?’’ on your mind? The answer is AI-powered systems. Indeed, these systems have changed mortgage processing workflows through their deployment in the industry. They use advanced extraction methods to extract data from documents which enables risk assessment that supports underwriters. Natural Language Processing and Optical Character Recognition technology work together in AI systems to authenticate information in borrower documents. Further, AI forecasts underwriting results but it lacks the capacity to execute the decisions which underwriters require. Factually, AI extracts data from past loan records while using its evaluation function to support risk assessment and decision-making processes. Lenders use AI technology to improve their decision-making abilities through the use of predictive analytics. It shortens the time required for loan processing while it improves the capacity to monitor compliance. Technical Plugins Often Overlooked Many Enterprise Lenders are not taking full advantage of the more advanced technical plug-in technologies available. Some examples of these advanced plugins are: Plugin Name Function Enterprise Benefits Post-closing Automation Simplifies doc review, preps marketing docs Lessens delay and ensures audit compliance Data Validation & Quality Control Identifies missing/inconsistent data Improves accuracy and decreases rework Version Control & Audit Trail Monitors changes made to documents and workflow Provides tools to assist with regulatory audits and hold people accountable to them Sandbox/Testing Plugins Tests system updates without risking data disruption Avoids conflicts between integrated applications API/Middleware Optimization Provides real-time data synchronization Provides for seamless integration to CRM/LOS and 3rd party applications Mobile/Remote Access Solutions Enables secure remote workflow Supports agent loan officers in the field and remote employees Advanced plugins leverage real-time APIs, sandbox testing, version control, and middleware optimization to ensure seamless integration and minimize workflow disruption. Security & Data Protection Plugins Encryption, multiple levels of access control, and secure authentication mechanisms are available in security data protection plugins and services. These mechanisms provide secured access to sensitive information about borrowers. This reduces the risk of any unauthorized changes or breaches of that sensitive information. The protection plugins also support lenders’ compliance with federal and state laws including but not limited to: The Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA) The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) State specific privacy regulations Some form of compliant, audit-ready documentation Traceable audit and access logs By employing automated security protocols, protection plugins are designed to help eliminate human mistakes and ensure continual protection of the data. Customization & Tailored Workflows Mortgage teams can tailor Encompass LOS to fit their workflows using customization plugins. In modern times, many companies are opting for customized Encompass plugin to automate loan processing. Custom forms, fields, triggers, and automation rules that reflect lenders’ business processes can be created, maximizing consistency between departments. Using customization tools, enterprise teams will find scaling their operations easier because standardizing workflows helps maintain flexibility and deliver a unique borrower experience. An example is when one large lender created a customized trigger to request documentation automatically by loan type. Ultimately, employing custom workflows improves both operational efficiencies and borrower experiences by delivering a consistent, professional, and timely loan process. Choosing the Right Plugins: Evaluation & ROI Step 1: Identify Workflow Pain Points Make a list of tasks and processes that are performed repeatedly, where bottlenecks exist or where delays occur. Identify areas of compliance that aren’t being met or where communication issues exist. Step 2: Evaluate Features & ROI Look through all of the plugins to determine each one’s capabilities. Find benefits like hours saved for each loan, fewer errors, faster time to close, and better experience for the borrower. Compare the costs vs. time/efficiencies gained to prioritize your available high-impact solutions. Step 3: Check Integration & Compatibility Confirm that the plugin will integrate well with both your LOS and CRM systems, and any other third-party solution. Select those tools that require the least amount of customization to limit the risk in implementation and to remove system-to-system conflicts. Follow a step-by-step evaluation process, roll out in a structured manner, and track KPIs so that plugins are effectively adopted and yield the highest level of efficiency and ROI. Implementation Best Practices Plan a Smooth Rollout Implement a detailed rollout plan outlining timelines, responsibilities, and system dependencies for a successful implementation Train Your Team Train all involved loan officers, processors, and IT individuals through in-person training sessions with adequate documentation. Promote Adoption Encourage employees to utilize plug-ins in their daily activities through early observation of plug-in usage and additional assistance. Avoid Common Mistakes Don’t miss the opportunity for a pilot test. Do not overload your workforce by implementing too many changes at once. Ensure all integration points have been validated thoroughly. Follow Enterprise-Proven Practices To achieve the fastest rate of adoption, greatest efficiency, and best ROI, refer to case studies Measuring Plugin Impact & KPIs When evaluating whether your Encompass plugin is providing measurement of value; you should track key performance indicators (KPIs). These include loan cycle time, error rates, and borrower satisfaction scores. Tracking these metrics before and after the Encompass plugin implementation shows you how much more efficient you are now than you were before. The ultimate goal is to quantify the amount of time saved by using the Encompass plugin compared to the cost of investment to produce a (ROI). Automating activities such as document routing and task assignment can reduce manual processing time by hours for each loan. You must continually optimize your process by reviewing KPIs regularly, refining workflows and adjusting triggers and/or automation rules. When lenders track KPIs, they are able to proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in their process. Enterprise Case Studies & Practical Examples Small Lender: A local mortgage company implemented automating workflows with plugins that resulted in a 20% decrease in loan processing time and improved accuracy. Mid-Size Lender: By using compliance, documentation & CRM-based plugins, a regional lender decreased loan approval times by 30% and improved the satisfaction score for borrowers by 15%. Large Enterprise Lender: A national lender utilized several plugins to implement A.I.-based risk scoring and reporting dashboards, which resulted in 35% quicker loan throughput and reported a measurable ROI. This resulted in a 35% faster loan throughput and a measurable ROI in both cost savings and borrower retention. Through the use of custom plugins, lenders ranging from small offices to large enterprise organizations reported faster loan processing times between 20% and 35%. Common Challenges & How to Overcome Them The challenges of implementing multiple Encompass plugins can be overcome through proactive strategies: 1. Resistance to Change: Employees may feel reluctant to establish new work routines. Therefore, employee training, thorough documentation, and showcasing early successes creates motivation for them to adopt these new processes. 2. Integration Issues: Encompass plugins will need to integrate with your existing LOS, CRM, and other third-party systems. You should conduct ample testing in an isolated testing environment (sandbox) before going live to avoid potential conflicts between these systems. 3. Managing Multiple Plugins: Multiple overlapping systems can be confusing for employees. To reduce this confusion, have one central place where you manage your plugins. Additionally, you should identify who is primarily responsible for that particular plugin system. By anticipating the potential challenges and identifying proactive approaches to addressing the issues, lenders can achieve smoother implementation and quicker adoption of their plugin ecosystem. Future Trends & 2026 Outlook According to MBA Research 2026 forecasts, AI and cloud-enabled plug-ins will help lenders to process loans 25 – 35% faster, with quantifiable ROI improvement as well. The mortgage technology landscape is rapidly changing; the trends in plug-in adoption by 2026 indicate that there will be major changes. Hyper-automation and artificial intelligence will continue to automate tedious processes, improve underwriting, and reduce faulty decisions. With the growth of cloud-based plug-ins, lenders will have access to real-time data, can create remote workflows and connect their systems seamlessly. Predictive analytics will become increasingly prevalent, allowing lenders to identify potential bottlenecks, evaluate risk, and better optimize pipeline efficiency. Final Thoughts & Action Steps These days, Encompass Plugins are not an option. They are required by all mortgage lenders who want their mortgage processes to be as fast, accurate and scalable as possible. Encompass Plugins allow lenders to gain a clear competitive advantage through automation of their repetitive tasks, improving compliance and enhancing their communication with borrowers. Next Steps: Evaluate the current workflow you have in place and identify your pain points Implement a pilot on high impact plugins with a small team or loan segment Once you have proven your success, utilize the Encompass plugin to automate loan processing it in every way possible throughout your whole company. Ready to streamline your lending workflow? Explore our Encompass plugin development solutions to automate processes, reduce manual work, and accelerate loan approvals today. Get Started Today FAQs 1. Are Encompass LOS plugins easy to install? Yes to some extent. Depending on some company settings, some plugins may need access to administrator privileges or support from IT. Testing the Plug-ins in a sandbox will help ensure they are integrated properly into existing workflows and do not disrupt the existing workflow of other applications. 2. How do I know which plugin is right? Base your decision on what will be best for your organization, including your workflow and return on investment. Be able to know where the pain points are in your current workflow. When comparing plugins, also consider the features of the plugin (i.e.. Ease of integration, % change in efficiency gained). 3. Do Encompass plugins improve compliance? Yes, Encompass Plugins will automate compliance-related regulatory reviews, keep records that are ready for a compliance audit, and maintain adequate records about regulatory updates (i.e. CFPB, TRID, and HMDA). Plug-ins for compliance will assist lenders with compliance. But lenders will still need to have oversight of the use of the plug-ins for compliance. It is because regulators still require that all compliance changes made to lenders be verified through a manual review. 4. Are there free plugins? Some exist, but most advanced tools are paid. Free plugins usually provide limited functionality. Paid versions offer automation, analytics, and enterprise-level support necessary for mid-size and large lenders. 5. How secure are third-party plugins? Yes, they are generally secure if they have undergone a proper vetting process. You should verify that they have encryption standards, access control and vendor compliance practices. Using approved plugins helps protect sensitive borrower’s information against data breaches. 6. What is the ROI of using plugins? Yes, typically, plugins have a strong return on investment. They help save time, reduce errors and improve customer experience. By implementing automation and using plugins, lenders have seen a significant reduction in their processing time for loans (usually 25-35% faster) and operational cost savings. 7. How often should plugins be updated? You should update your plugins regularly and with each new version released because new releases may also include regulatory changes and bug fixes. Performing regular checks will help prevent potential conflicts between the systems you have installed and to ensure the plugins continue to provide you with efficiency.
